## Playbook

- [ ] I read FEATURE-PLAYBOOK.md for this change
- [ ] `npm run check` is green
- [ ] Tests cover new behavior (or this PR is docs-only)
- [ ] No new dependency — or it is approved and in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md
- [ ] User actions are commands + contracts
- [ ] Data changes include RLS policies + policy tests
- [ ] Docs/glossary/PROJECT-MEMORY updated if a decision or noun changed
- [ ] Depth matched the work; Standard/Comprehensive had an accepted bolt plan
- [ ] No god file, no `any`, no sibling-repo databases on any path
